Bloom filter allocation, initialization, insert, and membership test functions.

# Purpose
This file implements the core operations for a Bloom filter stored in shared memory. It defines the alignment and memory footprint rules in [`fd_bloom_align`](<#fd_bloom_align>) and [`fd_bloom_footprint`](<#fd_bloom_footprint>), then provides construction and validation functions such as [`fd_bloom_new`](<#fd_bloom_new>) and [`fd_bloom_join`](<#fd_bloom_join>) for creating or attaching to an existing `fd_bloom_t` object. The code also includes [`fd_bloom_initialize`](<#fd_bloom_initialize>) to set the filter size and random hash keys from an `fd_rng_t`, plus [`fd_bloom_init_inplace`](<#fd_bloom_init_inplace>) for direct setup when the caller already owns the backing arrays.

The file also defines the Bloom filter data path. The local [`fnv_hasher`](<#fnv_hasher>) function applies an FNV-style hash with a per-key seed, and [`fd_bloom_insert`](<#fd_bloom_insert>) and [`fd_bloom_contains`](<#fd_bloom_contains>) use that hash to set and test bits in the filter. The implementation stores the hash keys, bit array, false positive rate, and size limits inside `fd_bloom_t`, and it uses logging and alignment checks to validate inputs before use.
